* Experience in patents or publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing
* Hands\-on experience developing and deploying Visual Inertial Odometry or visual\-inertial SLAM systems
* Strong understanding of multi\-sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, odometry) and state estimation (EKF, factor graphs)
* Experience optimizing perception algorithms for embedded or resource\-constrained hardware
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with real sensor data, calibration, and physical robot platforms
* Familiarity with modern ML approaches to perception (learned feature extraction, depth prediction, end\-to\-end odometry)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Publication record at major robotics or computer vision conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CVPR, ECCV)
* Experience with real\-time systems programming and performance profiling on ARM/GPU platforms
* Experience with state estimation on legged robots

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**About Outtake**
=================


Outtake exists to empower and facilitate trust for a digital\-first world. Today, impersonation, fraud, AI\-driven scams, and identity abuse spread faster than any security team can respond to. So we built something different: an agentic AI platform that proactively detects, monitors, and takes down impersonators, automating protection in hours, not weeks.

  

Built by ex\-Palantir, ex\-CTO/founders, and ex\-Notion engineers, Outtake is designed for clarity, autonomy, and velocity. Our goal is ambitious: become the trust layer of the modern internet. And we intend to do it with a lean, dense, exceptionally talented team.

  

Outtake is backed by top\-tier investors and operators who believe in our mission and our model. With strong financial footing and a long runway, we prioritize creating an environment where people can do the best work of their careers.

**Software Engineer, Infrastructure**

**The Role**
===================================================


This is a staff\-level infrastructure generalist role. You will set the technical direction of Outtake’s infrastructure and build the systems that support our next orders of magnitude of growth. The role begins as an individual contributor position; experience growing and leading infrastructure teams will be valuable as the function scales.


Outtake needs to search, process, and investigate billions of pieces of content quickly. You will own the foundations that determine how this data is stored, indexed, retrieved, and moved; how asynchronous work is scheduled and executed; and how our systems use cloud compute, storage, and networking.


This is a software engineering role. You will design and build production infrastructure systems, expose them through clear internal interfaces and abstractions, and lead the migrations required to adopt them.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Set the technical direction for Outtake’s infrastructure across databases, search and retrieval, data processing, asynchronous execution, and cloud architecture.
* Redesign our search and retrieval systems to support fast investigation across billions of pieces of content.
* Evolve our relational database architecture through sharding, partitioning, indexing, caching, and new data\-access patterns.
* Own the application and infrastructure changes required to migrate live systems safely, including changes to service topology and deployment strategy.
* Design and build scalable asynchronous systems for scheduling, queues, workflows, retries, backpressure, rate limiting, and failure recovery.
* Build data infrastructure for high\-volume ingestion, streaming, batch processing, enrichment, and reprocessing.
* Develop shared infrastructure services, APIs, libraries, and primitives that product engineers can use without needing to understand the underlying implementation.
* Own the cloud foundations required by these systems, including compute, storage, networking, isolation, resource management, and deployment architecture.
* Evaluate build\-versus\-buy decisions and make tradeoffs across latency, throughput, consistency, durability, cost, and complexity.
* Work across engineering teams to identify repeated infrastructure problems and turn them into reusable systems.
* Operate the systems you build, use production evidence to improve their architecture, and automate recurring operational work.
* Write technical proposals, establish architectural standards, and guide other engineers through complex systems decisions.
* As the infrastructure foundation matures, we expect to grow this into a broader infrastructure team with dedicated ownership across data systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience operating at staff scope: identifying important technical problems, setting direction across team boundaries, and leading complex projects from design through adoption.
* A track record of designing and building distributed infrastructure systems used by other engineers or products.
* Experience scaling production systems through significant increases in data volume, traffic, or workload complexity.
* Deep knowledge of relational database architecture, including data modeling, access patterns, indexing, partitioning, sharding, caching, and migration.
* Experience building or evolving high\-throughput asynchronous systems, with a strong understanding of scheduling, ordering, retries, idempotency, backpressure, and partial failure.
* Experience with large\-scale search and retrieval systems, including the tradeoffs among lexical search, vector retrieval, indexing speed, freshness, relevance, and cost.
* Experience building ingestion, streaming, or batch\-processing systems for large data volumes.
* Work across the underlying cloud infrastructure when changes to compute, storage, networking, or deployment architecture are required to scale our data systems.

**Life at Outtake**
===================

* **Office:** For those in NY, we are an in\-person team (5 days a week, with flexibility as needed) working out of a stunning waterfront office in Brooklyn. Collaboration, speed, and clarity matter.
* **Health:** 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision for employees.
* **Time Away:** Flexible PTO. We trust adults to manage energy, not clock time.
* **Culture \& Team:** Annual company retreats and regular in\-person events.


Outtake is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.


Compensation Range: $160K \- $300K

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel)
jobs.description:
**About PactFi**


Private asset markets (PE, Private Credit, VC, Real Estate) have 10x to 9\.8T in AUM over the past decade and are projected to grow to $17T in the next five years. However, digital infrastructure has not kept pace, with most of the market operating predominantly in error\-prone, internal\-only software solutions.


PactFi provides secure, end\-to\-end, operational infrastructure for managing complex private credit transactions. Our web\-based application brings together all parties involved in such a transaction to more efficiently allocate capital, complete KYC, share documents, manage funds flow, and more. The platform is secured to a bank\-grade standard, and we have received our SOC 2 Type 2 attestation.


PactFi was developed in close partnership with two of the industry's largest players, both of whom represent the top 3 players in the private credit space by both size (AUM) and deal activity.


PactFi is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help build and ship features across our platform. You'll work primarily in our Laravel codebase, with regular front\-end work in Vue.js, on products that move real money for our partners and their clients.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer with a couple of years under their belt who wants to grow quickly. You'll own features end to end with support from senior engineers, and you'll get direct exposure to product, QA, and engineering leadership rather than working from a ticket queue.


Key Responsibilities

* Build and ship features in our Laravel application, from database schema through API endpoints to the Vue.js interface.
* Write clean, tested, well\-documented code and participate actively in code review.
* Integrate with third\-party APIs and internal services, handling errors, retries, and edge cases thoughtfully.
* Work with Product Managers and QA to clarify requirements, break down work, and get features to production.
* Debug and resolve issues across the stack, including performance and data\-integrity problems.
* Contribute to improving our tooling, tests, and development workflow.


Qualifications

* 2\-4 years of professional software development experience.
* Working experience with Laravel (or another modern MVC framework, with genuine interest in Laravel).
* Solid PHP fundamentals and comfort with object\-oriented design.
* Front\-end experience with Vue.js, React, or similar, plus solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Practical SQL skills and experience designing and querying relational databases (MySQL or similar).
* Familiarity with Git\-based workflows and code review.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to ask questions early.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience writing automated tests (Playwright, or similar).
* Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform.
* Experience with queues, background jobs, or event\-driven workflows.
* Interest in fintech, financial services, or regulated environments.
* Any hands\-on experience with LLM APIs or AI\-assisted features.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary \+ equity.
* Healthcare coverage.
* 401k


Compensation Range: $185K \- $200K

jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------


You will build and operate components of our data platform: the pipelines that move healthcare data from customer EHR systems into Snowflake, and the models that turn that raw data into trusted core entities. You will work within workstreams scoped and architected with senior engineers on the team, and own your components end to end \- building them, testing them, running them in production, and fixing them when they break.


This is a growth role. You will get direct exposure to enterprise\-scale healthcare data problems, a modern stack (Snowflake, SQLMesh, Temporal, Python, AWS, Datadog), and senior engineers invested in ramping you. The expectation is a steep trajectory: components today, workstreams as you grow.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Build and maintain pipeline components within larger workstreams, with architecture guidance from senior engineers.
* Write production Python and SQL: extract logic, transformations, and data quality checks.
* Contribute to our core entity models and learn the RCM domain that drives them.
* Debug data quality and pipeline issues through to root cause, not just symptom.
* Run what you build. You join the on\-call rotation with support from senior engineers.
* Develop AI\-natively. AI coding tools (Claude Code and similar) are part of how this team designs, builds, and reviews.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

* 2\+ years of software or data engineering experience with production code you can walk through in detail.
* Solid Python and SQL fundamentals. You may not have deep warehouse experience yet, but you understand how data moves through a system.
* Exposure to at least one part of the modern data stack: a cloud warehouse, an orchestration tool, or a transformation framework.
* Strong debugging instincts and honesty about what you know versus what you are guessing.
* You respond well to feedback and probing \- depth may still be developing, but the fundamentals and the trajectory are visible.
* Interest in healthcare data. You do not need domain experience, but you need the appetite for a messy, regulated domain.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Snowflake, SQLMesh/dbt, Temporal, or AWS exposure.
* Any prior contact with healthcare, claims, or other regulated data domains.

  

The base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $190,000\. Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer an annual bonus program, company equity, and a competitive benefits package.

**About Adonis**
================


Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose\-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.


Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI\-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================


Actual base pay will depend on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer\-paid medical insurance
* Employer\-paid dental insurance
* Employer\-paid vision insurance
* Employer\-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city


Adonis is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.


At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Responsibilities
  
  

**About the Team:**  

The Search team is dedicated to building a fully managed, one\-stop platform for information retrieval and analytics. Deeply compatible with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, and Milvus, the platform serves four core scenarios—GenAI applications, search, security, and observability—and provides comprehensive capabilities across full\-text search, vector search, geospatial search, and hybrid search. We are also building next\-generation Agentic Search products, including RAG, AI\-powered search, and multimodal retrieval, continuously pushing the boundaries of intelligent search technology.
  
We are deeply involved in the open\-source ecosystem and have contributed hundreds of PRs across the OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Lucene, and Milvus communities. Several members of our team hold key leadership roles in these communities, including Governing Board Member, Technical Steering Committee Member, PMC Member, and Maintainer, helping shape the evolution of the broader search and database ecosystem through sustained technical contributions.
  
On the business side, we not only provide reliable infrastructure for some of ByteDance’s largest\-scale vector and full\-text hybrid search workloads, but also deliver enterprise\-grade cloud search services to external customers through Volcano Engine, helping businesses unlock growth through data. We embrace a pragmatic yet ambitious engineering culture: while continuously publishing innovative research at top\-tier conferences such as VLDB and ICDE, we remain strongly focused on real\-world impact and commercial adoption, building a comprehensive product portfolio that serves a wide range of search and AI use cases.
  
Our team brings together leading database researchers and exceptional engineers from around the world. We are looking for talented individuals with expertise in search or vector database engine development, distributed systems architecture, or AI model innovation to join us. Together, we will explore uncharted technical territory, define the data foundation for the AI era, and empower both ByteDance and enterprises across industries to achieve AI\-driven transformation.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Build Agentic Search and Analytics systems that combine planning, retrieval, reasoning, tool execution, and iterative agentic loops.
* Develop multi\-source and multimodal search across structured data, documents, images, audio, and video.
* Build a unified semantic layer for heterogeneous enterprise data, including entities, metrics, metadata, and relationships.
* Explore semantic accumulation and self\-evolving agents that continuously improve through interactions, feedback, memory, and historical executions.


Qualifications
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
* B.S in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Strong coding, data structures, and algorithm skills; proficient in Python, Java, C\+\+, or Golang.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Agents, Search, RAG, Information Retrieval, or Machine Learning.
* Strong problem\-solving, learning, and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience with Agentic Search, Data Agents, RAG, or AI Search through research, internships, or projects.
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Milvus, Faiss, Qdrant, or similar retrieval systems.
* Experience with tool calling, MCP, Skills, memory, planning, or agent evaluation.
* Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, multimodal retrieval, or large\-scale data processing.

new_jobs.title: Applied Scientist - Perception (SLAM/VIO), Fauna
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are seeking an Applied Scientist to develop and optimize Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) and sensor fusion systems for our intelligent robots. In this role, you will design, implement, and deploy state estimation and tracking algorithms that enable robots to understand their position and motion in real time, even in challenging and dynamic environments.
  

  

You will own the full pipeline from algorithm development through embedded deployment, ensuring that perception systems run efficiently on resource\-constrained robotic hardware. You will also leverage modern machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of classical perception methods, combining learned representations with geometric techniques to achieve robust, real\-time performance.
  

  

This is a deeply hands\-on role. You will work directly with sensors, hardware, and real\-world data, while prototyping, testing, and iterating in physical environments. The ideal candidate has strong foundations in VIO and sensor fusion, practical experience optimizing algorithms for embedded platforms, and familiarity with how modern deep learning is transforming perception.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement Visual Inertial Odometry algorithms for robust real\-time state estimation on robotic platforms like Sprout
* Develop multi\-sensor fusion pipelines integrating cameras, IMUs, and other sensing modalities for accurate pose tracking
* Optimize perception and tracking algorithms for deployment on embedded hardware (e.g., ARM, GPU\-accelerated edge devices) under strict latency and power constraints
* Apply modern ML\-based perception techniques (learned features, depth estimation, neural odometry) to complement and improve classical geometric approaches
* Build and maintain calibration, evaluation, and benchmarking infrastructure for perception systems
* Collaborate with hardware, controls, and navigation teams to integrate perception outputs into the robot’s autonomy stack
* Lead technical projects from research prototyping through production deployment
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing
* Hands\-on experience developing and deploying Visual Inertial Odometry or visual\-inertial SLAM systems
* Strong understanding of multi\-sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, odometry) and state estimation (EKF, factor graphs)
* Experience optimizing perception algorithms for embedded or resource\-constrained hardware
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with real sensor data, calibration, and physical robot platforms
* Familiarity with modern ML approaches to perception (learned feature extraction, depth prediction, end\-to\-end odometry)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience using Unix/Linux

* Publication record at major robotics or computer vision conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CVPR, ECCV)

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record\-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.



Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.



Backed by **Sequoia Capital**, **Multicoin Capital**, and **The Chainsmokers**, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well\-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

**We are hiring a Full Stack Engineer!**
----------------------------------------



As our Full Stack Engineer, you'll work across the stack to design, build, and ship user\-facing payment products end to end, turning complex financial workflows into intuitive, reliable experiences. This is a hands\-on, product\-centric role where your engineering decisions directly shape what our customers use every day. You'll operate with real autonomy: scoping projects yourself, using AI tools to plan and navigate a large codebase, and driving work from ambiguous requirements to a shipped product without heavy oversight.



You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Operations on requirements, UX decisions, and technical tradeoffs, and work with Risk and Compliance to make sure product workflows hold up to regulatory and operational reality.



We're looking for someone who thrives in fast\-moving environments, wants meaningful ownership, and is excited to build rather than simply maintain.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Build and scale user\-facing fintech products that power Breeze's payments platform.
* Use AI tools (Claude Code and similar) as a core part of your workflow to scope, plan, and execute large projects across a large, multi\-service codebase.
* Independently break down ambiguous, multi\-week projects into shippable milestones and manage your own execution.
* Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through iteration based on user feedback.
* Work in a full stack environment using React.js and TypeScript on the frontend, and Node.js and TypeScript on the backend.
* Partner closely with Product and Design to shape product requirements, UX decisions, and technical tradeoffs.
* Design systems that are secure, scalable, and performant in a payments and financial context.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams to ensure product workflows meet regulatory and operational needs.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders and contribute to product planning and prioritization.
* Participate in our on\-call and engineering runner rotations, triaging production alerts and merchant\-facing issues and closing them out end to end.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in fintech, payments, or fast\-paced startup environments.
* Experience building product\-driven, user\-facing applications.
* Fluent with AI coding tools; you know how to use them to scope work, understand unfamiliar parts of a large repository, and ship faster without sacrificing quality.
* Familiarity with tools that power AI: agent tooling, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, etc.
* Solid full stack experience with React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript, or similar modern frameworks.
* Product mindset, with genuine care for usability, customer experience, and business impact.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to own features from concept to launch. You can take a loosely defined project, scope it, sequence it, and deliver it with minimal supervision.
* Excellent communication skills and comfort working cross\-functionally with non\-engineering partners.
* Familiarity with building scalable, reliable systems and modern web architectures.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving environments without an established playbook.
* A builder mentality with a strong bias toward action.
* Comfortable getting into the details and doing the work, regardless of seniority.

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup.
* Exposure to payments, financial APIs, risk systems, or crypto and blockchain products.
* Experience working in large, established codebases or multi\-service architectures.

**Why Breeze**
--------------


* **More than payments:** We're building an intelligent infrastructure layer across payments, compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.
* **AI from the ground up:** AI isn't an add\-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate.
* **Successful and still early:** We have meaningful traction and strong financial foundations while remaining early enough for new hires to have outsized impact.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.  



As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and community Banking, you will help build, operate, and scale **AWS\-based production environments** (with a focus on **EKS/ECS**), support secure edge delivery via **Akamai**, and enable the deployment and ongoing operation of **AI enabled services/workflows**. You will be a key contributor to reliability, observability, automation, and operational excellence.  



**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Manage, scale, and troubleshoot AWS infrastructure, focusing on containerized workloads running on EKS and ECS. Provision and maintain infrastructure using Terraform to ensure repeatable, standards\-based deployments across environments. Support and improve CI/CD pipelines for application and AI\-enabled feature releases (deployment automation, rollback support, and environment promotion). Collaborate with engineering teams to implement operational best practices (health checks, readiness, scaling, and resiliency patterns).
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Administer and optimize Akamai CDN configurations for performance, caching, and edge troubleshooting. Implement and maintain Akamai Client Side Protection (CSP) configurations and support web security controls to reduce client\-side threats (e.g., XSS/data exfiltration). Support certificate lifecycle activities (CSR generation, SAN/hostname validation, chain deployment, renewal coordination) and schedule changes to minimize downtime. Follow secure operational practices around secrets handling, access controls, and vulnerability remediation coordination
* Build and maintain dashboards and alerts using tools such as Splunk and metrics\-based monitoring to improve early detection and reduce false positives. Participate in incident response: triage, escalation, mitigation, stakeholder updates, and post\-incident follow\-ups. Contribute to root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventative fixes to reduce recurrence. Create and maintain operational documentation (runbooks, SOPs, on\-call playbooks).
* Support change management: peer reviews, risk awareness, pre/post checks, and safe execution during maintenance windows. Working knowledge of incident and change management practices (ITSM mindset, clear comms, disciplined execution).  

  

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS and container platforms (EKS and/or ECS).
* Experience using Terraform (or comparable IaC) for provisioning and managing infrastructure.


Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, networking fundamentals, and application/runtime behaviors.


Working knowledge of incident and change management practices (ITSM mindset, clear comms, disciplined execution).


Scripting/automation experience (e.g., Bash, Python, Perl) and CI/CD tooling exposure.
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


	+ Hands\-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
	+ Experience with **Splunk** (search, dashboards, alert tuning, log onboarding).
	+ Hands\-on experience with **Akamai** (CDN configs, caching strategy, edge troubleshooting) and CSP implementation.
	+ Proficiency in automation and continuous delivery methods
	+ Familiarity with operating AI\-enabled services or pipelines, including basic concepts around model/service rollouts and monitoring.
	+ AWS certification(s) (Cloud Practitioner or higher).


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.


We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. new_jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013\. Initially built to take the pain out of peer\-to\-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50\+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

  



Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.


### **The Role**



Cash App is offering a better way to file your taxes as an alternative to traditional online DIY tax preparation systems. As a Software Engineer on our Tax Engine Server Engineering team, you will build and enhance the codebase that powers our tax filing experience. You will translate complex tax requirements into seamless software solutions that help millions of users confidently navigate and complete their returns with ease.



You will collaborate closely with product managers, tax experts on our Tax Product Specialist team, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure our platform remains accurate, reliable, and easy to use. If you are a skilled engineer who thrives on solving complex problems and wants to make a direct impact on a transformative product within a rapidly growing company, this role is for you.


### **You Will**


* Design, build, and own high\-quality features and systems that power the Cash App Taxes filing experience, from federal and state form logic to e\-file submission.
* Translate complex tax rules and requirements into clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code in close partnership with Tax Product Specialists.
* Build tools and guardrails that enable non\-technical contributors to make code changes safely that maintain our quality standards.
* Drive architectural and design decisions, ensuring our tax software remains scalable, secure, and maintainable.
* Write reliable, well\-tested code and establish best practices for coding, testing, deployment, and documentation.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Quality Assurance, Tax Product Specialists, Cloud Platform, Design, Product, Customer Care, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues related to accuracy, reliability, and performance, balancing new feature development with ongoing maintenance.
* Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry best practices to continually refine our development processes.
* Apply an AI\-first mindset in your everyday work, raising the bar of AI application on our team

### **You Have**


* 4\+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in a fast\-paced or product\-centric environment. Experience in the tax industry is a major plus.
* Strong technical skills in backend development, including system design, architecture, and object\-oriented programming.
* A track record of delivering reliable, high\-quality software solutions on schedule.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with attention to detail and a methodical approach to debugging and implementation.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Passion for building innovative software that simplifies complicated processes for everyday users.

### **Technologies We Use and Teach**


* Java / Kotlin
* iBatis / SQL Relational Databases
* Logging \& monitoring tools — Datadog, Splunk, New Relic
* GCP / AWS
* GitHub
* HTTP, JSON, gRPC, Protocol Buffers
* Okta
* Linear
* AI Coding Agents (Claude, Codex, etc.)
